component_rules: Snapshot normalization, fingerprinting, hashing, ordering, and terminal protection use one provider-neutral aggregator.
Carrier mapping, Provider configuration, query throttle, leases, retry, masking, and safe error behavior live in dedicated services.
Tracking summaries, timelines, status presentation, refresh state, risk presentation, and visibility-aware polling are reusable frontend components or hooks.
Complete tracking data is stored by order and delivery, never copied into every schedule block.
Supplier protocol conversion stays inside integration.logistics.kuaidi100.
